spans.text: "justification": "KEEP. PRE-BUILT DISCLOSURE (mandatory, repeated per CYCLE_DESIGN PRE-BUILT CYCLES): this change was BUILT and MEASURED in the isolated P1 worktree BEFORE this cycle's OPEN. The passing predictions below are CONFIRMATIONS of measurements already taken, not blind pre-registrations; the freeze's temporal guarantee was already absent at OPEN and no procedure restores it. Option A (restore-then-reapply) was used: the three files_to_change were restored to their pre-P1 bytes (git HEAD) at OPEN, and the reviewed P1 bytes re-applied as the IMPLEMENT step with byte-identity verified against the sha256 recorded at save (4323c0cc/c98dae00/c3af4683); that check is what makes the re-application legitimate rather than a re-implementation. No future reader should mistake this cycle's passing predictions for blind ones. BASIS FOR KEEP (document-side and mechanical; no panel-derived count moved, so this is not a keep-because-a-number-moved): (1) the independent clean-context change-review returned PROCEED — freeze shas exact, declared-diff-only verified against the OPEN restore, three mutants killed (DEGENERATE_QUOTE_FLOOR 14->25, structural arm disabled, locator restriction disabled), fence scan clean, and the claim verified that match_passage_v2 implements locator restriction + the load-bearing structural refusal + the floor backstop + the F9 empty-meta skip with v1 byte-untouched and default at every entry point; (2) all five design_vs_reality items ACCEPTED against the superseded floor-25 originals and the regenerated maps; (3) the DEGENERATE_QUOTE_FLOOR 25->14 deviation is ratified (manifest.deviation_ratification); (4) MEASURE shows 0 flips and predicted sets 95/73/146 identical to the baseline, so the join is downstream of the scorer and cannot regress a clause-level number — prediction_check 3/3 PASS. noop is recorded false only because the annotations input sha differs from the S1 baseline (S2's proven-bit-identical chain backfill landed after the decoration-blind-join snapshot); scores and thresholds are unchanged. Re-measurement of historical passage-level numbers rides the S8 checkpoint census (design §4); until then v1 remains the default at every entry point and no published number moves. No census, panel, judge, or gold number informed this decision.",
"signed_by": "session coordinator (Qwen Code), on Matt Stults's standing authorization — Option-A (restore-then-reapply) ruling 2026-08-04"

"design_vs_reality": {
  "1_floor_calibration_was_a_published_universe_artifact": "Design §2b claimed only ONE quote under 25 normalized chars ('71 of the 863 published passages...'). On the TRUE 589-locator universe there are EIGHT sub-25 quotes; seven discriminate perfectly (exactly one in-section clause each: 'Sending emails' 14, 'Example: mic check' 18, 'Example: tooth fairy' 20, 'Example: tedious task' 21 — REFERENCE-GRADE, 'Example: losing a parent' 24, 'Example: no revenue goal' 24, plus 'Types of uncertainty' 20 which is an empty-meta self-map). At floor 25 the join refused a reference-grade passage's correct mapping, violating §3.2. REMEDY PRE-REGISTERED BY THE DESIGN ITSELF ('the floor moves down, not the refusal semantics'): floor recalibrated 25 -> 14, the largest value sparing every measured discriminating quote. No floor separates the offender (21) from 'Example: tedious task' (21); the offender is caught by the structural arm, which the F12 ruling names load-bearing precisely so the backstop need not carry this.",
  "2_definitions_para5_collapse_refuted": "Design §3.1 predicted #definitions>¶5 collapses 6 -> 1 under restriction ('all six candidates collapse to the definitions section and containment then discriminates'). MEASURED: all six candidates (m0056-m0061) are ALREADY in section definitions, five are contained IN the passage (the legitimate one-to-many direction) and the sixth matches via a link variant; restriction does nothing and the structural arm correctly does not fire. v2 leaves it at 6. The 6-fan-out is segmentation granularity (one ¶ split into six definition clauses), not the join defect.",
  "3_empty_meta_noop_refuted": "SEGMENTATION_GAPS_DESIGN §4 predicted the skip is a no-op ('nothing currently maps to them'). MEASURED: the four pseudo-heading paragraphs are themselves panel passages, each self-mapped 1:1 onto its own pseudo-heading clause under v1 (all non-reference; two of the four are NOT under any defensible floor at 26/27 chars, so the design's 'refused under the degenerate floor anyway' aside is also wrong). The corrected acceptance: exactly those four self-maps drop; no reference recall moves.",
  "4_structural_refusal_missed_a_case": "Design §3.1's 'exactly two locators change' missed #protect_privileged_information>¶14: an 'Example:' caption that is a proper substring of BOTH its section's clauses — refused by the structural arm's own stated semantics. Non-reference; booked as the second refusal.",
  "5_scope_note_default_version": "The design implies v2 becomes the join of record at P1; the implementation keeps v1 the default at every entry point because (a) §4 defers ALL re-measurement and disclosure to S8, and a default flip would silently move passage-level numbers mid-spine, and (b) the 589 tests-strong historical suite pins v1 semantics on synthetic fixtures with legitimately short quotes. v2 is fully wired and selected explicitly; the default flip is proposed as part of the S8 disclosure event.",
  "adjudication": "NOT adjudicated here per the P1 operator's mandate — items 1-4 are reported with mechanical evidence (measure/delta_v1_v2nomix.json) for the gate-window reviewer; the corrected pins above are what the frozen prediction should say if the reviewer accepts the attribution."
